name: Kinetic Network
description: Everything connected to one set of spinning shafts and gears.

pages.title: Kinetic Network
pages.text:
A **kinetic network** is every shaft, gear, belt and machine connected together. **Kinetic** is Create's word for parts that run on rotation.\
\
Everything on one network spins at the same speed, scaled by gear ratios, and shares one pool of stress capacity. Overstress it and the whole network stops.
